title: Listening to a Swing 7 track
summary: Playback of a track with Harry Allen and Dan Barrett, noting written and open parts.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Let me put on just a piece of this, I think I got —
And this is all written out, correct?
The solos aren’t. That’s Harry Allen and Dan Barrett. Slips through three chords.
The background is written. Now this is open.
This is written. That’s all written.
